name: 25D-NBOMe
toxicities: The archived page states that the LD50 has not been determined.
summary: Uncommon analogue of 2C-D. Extremely potent psychedelic with stimulating qualities. Could cause dangerous vasoconstriction at high doses. May induce uncomfortable body load.
saferUse: PsychonautWiki strongly recommends harm-reduction measures, advises against insufflation because precise measurement of microgram quantities is difficult, and says its dose information is educational rather than a recommendation.
metabolism: The archived page says little is known about human pharmacology, metabolism and toxicity. It provides no specific metabolic pathway or human metabolic findings; no pathway is inferred from related compounds.
